Answer: 100% recirculation, with some make up water as needed. 2. Section 2.1 & 2.2: Both sections state that the systems need to be able to connect to an existing treated water source via a 1” inlet, but it does not mention how the existing drain system work or how these systems are required to integrate. Question: Can you provide more information on the existing drain system(s) at the facility? Are there any drawings, photos, or existing equipment information for reference in system matching and ﬁt-up Answer: There is a trough drain that the unit will drain into. This drain will be on the back side of the units. 3. Section 2.2 Capacity vs. Box Size: Section 2.2 asks for a system with only two (2) 12”x18” substrate-based incubator boxes, but Section 2.2(a) requires a "Minimum total rearing space for 75,000 Coho Salmon eggs." Biologically, two 12"x18" trout- style boxes cannot safely support 75,000 Coho salmon eggs to the fry stage. Provide all personnel, equipment, tools, materials, vehicles, supervision, and other items and services necessary to deliver recirculating aquaculture systems. The location of delivery is Cole M. Rivers Hatchery, located at 200 Cole M. Rivers Drive, Trail, OR 97541. Comply with all local, state, and federal regulations in the completion of work. 2.0 Supply The recirculating aquaculture systems described below in Sections 2.1 and 2.2 must be available for installation within 120 calendar days of Contract Award. The supplied products shall meet all the requirements listed in this section. The recirculating aquaculture system racks shall be assembled at delivery. 2.1 Provide one self-contained 100% recirculating aquaculture systems with four individual racks of (4)- eight tray salmon incubators (32 total incubators) that must be new and in compliance with the following criteria: a. Minimum total rearing space for 75,000 Coho Salmon eggs b. Minimum and Maximum ambient air temperature: 32-100 degrees Fahrenheit c. Minimum and Maximum desired water temperature in the RAS: 42-56 degrees Fahrenheit d. Performs water oxygenation e. Has UV sterilization f. Includes foam sump filtration g. Includes rackin

r of the facility which may affect the performance of the work as well as any unhealthful or hazardous conditions or any delays or interference with the work caused by the employees or the Government. 3.8 Invoicing and Contract Administration The Local POC is anticipated to be: Kela F.
